patterns.message: Import design-system components from 'index.js', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Inter.
<AccordionItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: id, summary, details, disabled.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: children, src, alt, size, shape, badge, color, style.
<Avatar> shape must be one of 'circular' | 'rounded' | 'square'.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: content, color, dot, max, children, style.
<Badge> color must be one of 'error' | 'primary' | 'success'.

<Breadcrumbs> separator must be one of 'chevron' | 'slash'.

<Button> size must be one of 'large' | 'medium' | 'small' | 'xs'.
